title: Listen Live to Farm Aid 2026 with Willie Nelson, Neil Young & More
summary: Celebrate Farm Aid’s mission to build a vibrant, family farm-centered system of agriculture in America.
body_markdown:
Farm Aid returns for its 2026 festival on Saturday, September 26, bringing an all-star lineup to Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater in Virginia Beach, Virginia — and SiriusXM listeners can hear the entire festival live.


Beginning at 12pm ET, tune in to[Willie’s Roadhouse (Ch. 61)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/willies-roadhouse) or[Dave Matthews Band Radio (Ch. 30)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/dave-matthews-band-radio) in your car or on the SiriusXM app for SiriusXM’s exclusive audio broadcast of Farm Aid 2026.


[Willie’s Roadhouse Willie Nelson’s classic country Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogFarmAid2025-WilliesRoadhouse)


[Dave Matthews Band Radio 24/7 DMB hits & live tracks Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogFarmAid2025-DMBRadio)


The live coverage will feature performances throughout the day, plus backstage interviews with artists and family farmers, hosted by SiriusXM’s Dallas Wayne and Joey Black. The broadcast will also offer an inside look at Farm Aid and the organization’s year-round work supporting family farm agriculture.


This year marks the 17th year SiriusXM has carried Farm Aid on satellite radio.


### **How to Listen to Farm Aid 2026 Live**


Date: Saturday, September 26
Time: Beginning at 12pm ET
Lead Channel: Willie’s Roadhouse (Ch. 61)
Also Airing On: Dave Matthews Band Radio (Ch. 30)
Location: Veterans United Home Loans Amphitheater, Virginia Beach, Virginia


Listen in your car or on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogFarmAid2025-WilliesRoadhouse) .


### **Farm Aid 2026 Lineup**


Farm Aid’s 2026 lineup features performances from the organization’s artist Board members and a wide-ranging group of special guests. The festival has also added breakout artist Ty Myers, who grew up on a family cattle ranch outside Austin, Texas.

### **About Farm Aid**


Farm Aid brings together music, food, farmers, and agricultural experiences to raise funds and awareness in support of American family farmers. Since 1985, the organization has raised more than $90 million for programs that help farmers thrive, expand the Good Food Movement, promote family farm food, and advocate for a more family farm-centered agricultural system.


Farm Aid’s artist Board includes Willie Nelson, Neil Young, John Mellencamp, Dave Matthews, Margo Price, and Nathaniel Rateliff, who help host the annual festival in support of the organization’s mission.


For Farm Aid tickets, visit[farmaid.org/2026](http://farmaid.org/2026) . For venue information, visit[farmaid.org/festival/venue-information](http://farmaid.org/festival/venue-information) . More details are also available at[farmaid.org/festival](http://farmaid.org/festival) .
